title: Sheet Pan Chicken Shawarma
description: Cumin, coriander and turmeric chicken roasted with vegetables.

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs
olive oil, salt, pepper and lemon zest, for the vegetables

items.item: 10 to 12 in wraps or pitas, or cooked rice or quinoa for bowls
greens, pickled onions, crunchy vegetables and a sauce

steps.do: Heat the oven to 400F (205C) and line a large sheet pan with parchment. Whisk the marinade ingredients together in a small bowl.

Lay the chicken and vegetables on the pan, keeping them apart. Brush the chicken heavily with marinade. Dress the vegetables with olive oil, salt, pepper and a little lemon zest, or with any marinade left over.

Roast and check at 20 minutes; breasts finish before thighs. Toss the vegetables and keep roasting until the chicken is cooked through, 165F (74C) inside, and the vegetables are tender, 20 to 30 minutes in all. Cook any grain for bowls meanwhile.
Slice the chicken. Build bowls over grain, or wraps in warm pitas or tortillas with greens, pickled onions and crunchy vegetables, and finish with sauce.

notes: Make ahead: the chicken can sit in the marinade, sealed, for up to 48 hours. Cooked shawarma keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen; reheat in a warm oven or a skillet.

Swaps: tofu can share the pan and needs the full 30 minutes to crust. Shrimp cooks fast; add it only once the vegetables are nearly done, or sear it in the marinade in a skillet. Readers often double the marinade.
Low-carb bowls: roast riced cauliflower on a second pan with olive oil, salt, pepper, lemon zest and a pinch of cumin, tossing every 10 minutes until crisp in spots.
Pairs with Israeli Salad, Tahini Yogurt Sauce and Green Tahini Sauce; all four together are the Chicken Shawarma Salad card.
nutrition: Per bowl, with chicken breast and riced cauliflower, no sauce: 380 cal · 50.5 g protein · 15.2 g carbs · 5.4 g fiber · 4.9 g sugar · 13.2 g fat · 2.3 g sat fat · 148.9 mg cholesterol · 282.3 mg sodium
